note: Two sites on a shared gravel track that leaves the south side of US 6 about 2.4 miles east of PA 402. Rest Stop 1 is about 75 m from the highway, in earshot of it; Rest Stop 2 is about 160 m farther in and about 13 m higher. Open woodland with no cleared pad and no rest-area building; each site is listed at 10 ft wide, with a picnic table and fire ring, and the agency also offers the pair for group camping. Pack out trash. State forest roads are not plowed in winter. --Claude
summary: Both site pages re-read: O018 Rest Stop 1 and O019 Rest Stop 2 still listed and bookable online, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, 40 ft each, gravel pull-ins on a shared 300-ft driveway, clearance 15 ft. Count 2 / max 40 confirmed; pull_through false added. Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; booking/hookups/season confirmed; facilities none. Phone confirmed. Imagery (leaf-off, rendered, plus a 420-m frame): paved two-lane US 6 about 75 m north of O018, a faint track running south from it past O018 to O019, thin open woods, a dark vehicle-sized object by O018, an open field ~120 x 70 m south-east of O019; no building. Pin = O018's point (0 m); O019 161 m south. NHD: a swamp/marsh area 153 m from O018, nothing within 50 m.
flags: What 'Rest Stop' is on the ground: plain woodland sites off US 6, not a highway rest area: no building, lot or toilet on imagery, and no toilet attribute on either page. The name is DCNR's.

Narrow pads: both pages give 'Site Length: 90', 'Site Width: 10', 'This site is limited to 2 vehicles.' DCNR layer: 'Large Group Site, Large Trailer, RV, Tent', GroupCamping Yes. Imagery shows no defined pad under the thin canopy, so the 10-ft width could not be checked.

Driveway: listed 300 ft, shared. O018 is ~75 m (250 ft) from US 6 and O019 ~238 m (780 ft), so the 300 ft cannot be the whole way to O019. 3DEP from O019 north to US 6: 415.8 m at O019, 411.0 at 60 m, 406.3 at 119 m, 406.6 at 179 m, 402.3 at the highway = 13.5 m over 238 m, about 6% (no grade is listed on either page).

Directions on the page: 'along US6, approximately 1.1 miles west of the PA729 intersection or 2.4 miles east of the PA402 intersection'. 'PA729' is the page's own wording; the note uses only the PA 402 distance.
Road noise at O018 (75 m from US 6): in the note. Access is straight off a paved US highway, the easiest of the batch.
Waterfront: stays not waterfront (NHD: swamp/marsh 153 m from O018; nothing within 50 m of either).
